## The Goal of the Change
- [ ] To fix a bug
- [ ] To close an Issue
- [ ] To add something new (albiet there isnt much you can do considering that this is a simple integration)

## PR Checklist
- [ ] I have used AI in some capacity (I use AI so I'm fine with it just state how much you used it)
- [ ] I have performed tests on my Home Assistant instance to make sure this works fine
- [ ] My Pr will pass the checks
- [ ] My changes generate no new warnings or console errors.
- [ ] I have commented my code
- [ ] My code uses async for the async rule
